decisions.decision: Target a $50K runner-up prize on the balanced 3-criteria score
decisions.rationale: Education category prize is a gross-revenue race aiTA loses at $15/mo vs B2B at 3-10x ARPU; runner-up rewards AI-native edge

decisions.decision: Two-cohort split: trial cohort (sample essays, revenue) + DPA design-partner cohort (real essays, proof)
decisions.rationale: Revenue needs speed/no-PII; proof needs real student data/rigor — opposite data strategies

decisions.decision: Auto-finalize (confidence-thresholded On-the-Loop) is the #1 build before submission
decisions.rationale: Without it the AI-native Criterion B claim is narrated not true, and the video can't show unattended grading

decisions.decision: REDESIGN the voice-convergence proof: drop edit-rate, use GPT-judge (primary) + aggregated LUAR + holdout + OSF pre-reg
decisions.rationale: Borchers AIED 2026: 51.3% of teachers never edit AI feedback -> edit-rate uninterpretable; LUAR degrades on short text

decisions.decision: 14-day full-access trial (not permanent freemium); hold $15/mo + annual + thin free floor
decisions.rationale: EdTech trial->paid 24.8% vs freemium 2.6% (~10x); decisive for revenue in 9 weeks

decisions.decision: De-identification (already shipped) is the FERPA compliance keystone
decisions.rationale: Standard Vertex/Gemini is NOT FERPA-covered (only Workspace-for-Edu); de-id means no education record reaches Gemini -> 5-7 day launch posture
